blocks.intro: What's been happening in your life as you choose to begin?

prompts.text: What's been happening in your life as you choose to begin?
What answer sounds true — before it becomes impressive?
Why did I really say yes to this path?
prompts.subtext: Not the polished answer. The real one.

blocks.title: Let the body answer first
blocks.instruction: Sit in silence for sixty seconds. Let the body answer first. Then speak the answer under your breath — without editing it.

blocks.closing: Notice what feels newly possible now that the yes has been spoken.
